title: Graphing a Left-Shifted Reciprocal Hyperbola
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Analyze and describe the graph of y = 1 / (x + 2) by identifying its parent function, shift, asymptotes, domain, range, and intercepts.

steps.title: Identify the Parent Function and Horizontal Shift
steps.explanation: Replacing x with x + 2 in y = 1/x shifts the hyperbola 2 units to the left.
steps.why: Replacing x with x + 2 translates the graph horizontally by h = -2.

steps.title: Determine the Asymptotes, Domain, and Range
steps.explanation: The denominator vanishes at x = -2, giving a vertical asymptote at x = -2, while the horizontal asymptote remains y = 0.
steps.why: Exclusion of x = -2 splits the real line into (-infinity, -2) U (-2, infinity).

steps.title: Find the y-Intercept and Key Points
steps.explanation: The left branch lies in the third quadrant passing through (-3, -1); the right branch lies above the x-axis passing through (-1, 1) and the y-intercept (0, 1/2).
steps.why: Evaluating at x = -3, -1, 0 gives reference points on each branch.
